BL-1203 — An answered question is re-delivered to a role forever: 40 replays of one answer batch into the specifier's mailbox in a single day
What it solves: - "[2026-08-27] specifier: this ticket exists because the replay was
  mistaken for human insistence. Note 002877 in the same burst window —
  'Mine - leave it, I will reattach main myself' — is a genuine, distinct
  human reply and arrived through the same path, so the path is not
  uniformly brok…
Approval context: Filed with the mechanism NOT established, deliberately, because the measurement is unambiguous and the cost is being paid every twenty minutes while it stays unticketed. The counts and timestamps below were read from the mailbox, not inferred.
The suspect is the front-desk bot replay shape already …
BL-1203 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1203" (or "reject BL-1203 <reason>") to act.
